note: US/NY/CATH/PR/BAP/01057021. Born 18 December 1900. Same parish as her sister.

Born in Manhattan in December 1900, so twenty when she crossed. The family had gone back to Scilla by then -- this looks like her returning to the country of her birth. NOT IN THE FAMILY TREE, which does not have her at all.
Not obviously ours, but the given name is Generosa Costa's in masculine form and is rare. Recorded, not claimed.

what: Rocco Arena in the 1910 US census
note: With the 1900 census placing the household in Manhattan and Antonino born there in October 1902, his absence in 1910 supports the family going home to Scilla between 1902 and 1910 -- which is when Anna must have returned to marry Giuseppe Arena.
